issue.description: The beta-flagged Agents Archive is correct and complete. Detail ownership never strands the Inbox or the Archive, live-only keys explain themselves, read callers never fall back to the parked Inbox, every promised parking and parent seam exists, project banners show names, the TUI import closure is back to its pre-epic size, and the Archive goldens are stable and current.

issue.title: Detail ownership, stuck placeholders, and reader guards
issue.description: detail-ownership: record a fresh owner token at every debounced Inbox detail schedule so Inbox detail repaints after an Archive round trip. Keep hidden Inbox paths from cancelling or replacing the Archive's pending hydration on the shared debouncer. Repaint Archive detail when the controller moves the selection. Clear the stuck titled loading card when the cursor leaves a run, and drop hydration while the pulse is focused. Stop FINAL and tool-run live ticks for archived agents, and label partial replies as partial.

issue.title: Controller robustness, parent seams, and project display names
issue.description: controller-seams: stop off-thread probe errors from wedging the Archive controller. Drain a queued explicit open on idle, and coalesce overlapping idle rebuilds. Publish a typed found/owner/missing arrival outcome and clear unmatched exact names. Add the restored-row overlay seam with invalidation, and keep list option IDs unique. Show PROJECT_NAME on project banners through the project display snapshot.

issue.title: Live-key toasts, read isolation, marks, footer, help, and info row
issue.description: action-boundary-fixes: make live-only keys reach their Archive guards so they toast instead of being silently swallowed. Stop copy readers from falling back to the parked Inbox agent, and guard or route the remaining unaudited Inbox actions. Render Archive marks and refresh the footer after mark and cursor changes. Remove the nonfunctional Enter read hint, fix the overflowing help row, and gate help and leader chrome on the beta. Fix the info row's color, key label, and resize alignment (the cause of the flaky missing-index golden), and the exception chip drop order.
